turns.question: What share of candidates who applied in September 2026 reached the interview stage or beyond?
turns.answer: Of the 3 candidates who applied between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30, 2 are now at the hired stage (so at least 2 of 3, about 66.7 %, reached interview or beyond), and 1 is rejected, whose furthest stage the semantic layer cannot show; the layer gives each candidate's current stage, not the highest stage ever reached. Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
